items.work: Violin Concerto ‘To the Memory of an Angel’
items.performers: Isabelle Faust, violin; Orchestra Mozart; Claudio Abbado, conductor
items.label: harmonia mundi
items.note: Berg’s memorial to Manon Gropius brings Bach’s chorale ‘Es ist genug’ into its final Adagio. Faust’s changing violin colours and Abbado’s clear orchestral detail make the approach to that chorale especially moving.

links.title: harmonia mundi — Faust and Abbado, complete Berg concerto on HMC902105

items.performers: Schoenberg Quartet: Janneke van der Meer and Wim de Jong, violins; Henk Guittart, viola; Viola de Hoog, cello
items.label: Chandos
items.note: Six movements encode Berg’s love for Hanna Fuchs-Robettin, with the fast movements growing faster and the slow ones slower. The Schoenberg Quartet catches the changes of mood and rising intensity praised by Gramophone.
